purpose: Provide a deterministic conservative preflight that detects provable local conflicts among exact-match projected translation constraints and same-body-pair center-distance equalities/ranges before solver work is spent.

properties.constraints: existing seven-family UC constraint set: translation mounts, distance joints/limits, axis locks/limits and fixed-direction locks/limits

limitations: conservative local projected-translation and same-pair radial-distance checks only
does not prove global satisfiability, convergence, stability or physical correctness
distance reasoning does not span triangles, loops, coupled directions or other multi-pair geometry
near-parallel but non-identical directions are intentionally not merged
disabled analyzed constraints are validated but excluded from conflict intersections
does not change solver order, world state, collision behavior or donor source

proves: translation mounts conflict-check against aligned axis locks
axis and scaled fixed-direction constraints share an exact normalized projection group
same-pair distance equality/range intersections can prove compatible and contradictory radial intervals
reversed distance body pairs canonicalize without sign inversion
disabled conflicting constraints remain inert while invalid references still fail validation
bounded tolerance applies to projected and radial interval separation
same-runtime report checksum replay is deterministic

truth.basis: Only contradictions proven by interval intersection on exact normalized projections or the exact same body-pair distance scalar are reported; coupled geometric cases remain explicit non-claims.

agency.basis: The preflight remains advisory evidence and does not silently mutate constraints or force a repair.

continuity.basis: It reuses existing seven-family normalizers and leaves the byte-for-byte donor physics source and solver behavior unchanged.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: It surfaces more locally provable contradictions before callers spend bounded solver passes on impossible same-pair constraint intervals.
